summary.zh: 路边与田埂常见的小型蕨类近亲，茎有节，富含硅质。
summary.en: A common roadside and field-edge relative of ferns with jointed, silica-rich stems.

field_marks.zh: 早春先出棕色孢子穗茎，之后长出绿色轮生枝的营养茎；茎节间中空。
field_marks.en: Brown spore-bearing shoots appear first in early spring, followed by green branched sterile shoots; hollow internodes.

story.zh: 木贼属是一个古老谱系，石炭纪的近亲曾长成大树。分子证据显示木贼类嵌套在真蕨类中，二者合称 monilophytes。
story.en: A very old lineage; Carboniferous relatives grew into trees. Molecular data nest horsetails within ferns, together forming the monilophytes.

notes.zh: 3–4 月孢子穗，之后至 9 月为绿色茎。
notes.en: Spore shoots in March–April; green shoots through September.
